count: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM oncall_roster WHERE shift_id=1 AND on_call=1
guard: SELECT shift_id FROM oncall_guard WHERE shift_id=1 FOR UPDATE
locking_roster: SELECT doctor_id FROM oncall_roster WHERE shift_id=1 AND on_call=1 ORDER BY doctor_id FOR UPDATE
leave: UPDATE oncall_roster SET on_call=0 WHERE shift_id=1 AND doctor_id=%s AND on_call=1
